approaches_tried.approach: Use a fixed, hardcoded literal path (docs/nonexistent-fixture-subject-zzyzx.md) as the genuinely-unmapped sentinel fixture
approaches_tried.reason: The literal placeholder string, once written into this test file's own source, becomes discoverable by suite_selection_select's grep-based reference stratum as a spurious self-reference from test-validate-artifact.sh to itself -- resolving to a real suite instead of the sentinel. Fixed by PID-suffixing the path so its exact runtime string never appears as a static substring in the source.

approaches_tried.approach: Use a real-suite path whose own basename is itself a test-*.sh file (test-validate-artifact.sh) for the sentinel(i) fixture
approaches_tried.reason: The claim-extraction token scan picks up the PATH ARGUMENT mention (since it matches the test-*.sh pattern) and misreads it as part of the claim, flipping claim_kind from sentinel to suitelist and coincidentally matching the real answer -- silently producing no warning where one was expected. Fixed by using a real-suite path (plan-file-scope-harvest.sh) whose own basename is not test-*.sh-shaped.
